indicates inclusion in the same manner as previously stated

items.question: Which additional substances are to be placed likewise in the prescribed ritual arrangement?
premises: Sesame and rice are included among the items.
Yellow pigment and the sahā plant are likewise included.
items.inference: These specified substances are to be placed in the same manner within the ongoing ritual procedure.
uncertainties: The exact identity of the disease-destroying substance is not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: Sesame and rice, a disease-destroying substance, yellow pigment, and the sahā plant should likewise be placed.
